correctness.rationale: For g=gcd(s,p^m-1)=11, the necessary Wendt resultant W11=101832157445630503 factors exactly as 23^5*67^2*89*199^2. For p=67,89,199 all eleventh roots of unity lie in Fp, and published quotient-normalization/product conditions restrict z=(-a)^t to 4,2,4 candidates respectively. Published inverse-power-sum Lemma 3.3 forces P11(tau,U1,z)=P22(tau,U2,z)=0 with tau=-11^{-1} mod p, U2=2U1 or 2U1-tau; independent exact finite-field formal-series recurrence exhausted all first-sum roots, checking 12+4+8=24 nonzero second residues. Each such p is impossible for every extension, not just tested q. At p=23, x*(x^11+2) permutes F23 by the square/nonsquare split; independently enumerated its 23 images. All quantifiers, t>2 and 22
